title: tk tui shows only awaiting ticks and ignores its scope flags
description:
`tk tui` shows only ticks whose `awaiting` field is set, and ignores the scope
flags meant to widen it. Every other view is empty as a result, so a repository
with real work in it looks empty.

Reproduced in /Users/peterengelbrecht/Development/ticfac at 2026-09-10:

- `tk list --all` reports 45 ticks. `tk rebuild` reports "Rebuilt index with 45
  ticks". `tk roadmap` reports 2 epics, one active and one ready.
- `tk tui` List view shows ONE row: n0r, the only tick in the repo with
  `awaiting: input`.
- Board view header reads `Open [0]  In Progress [0]  Awaiting [1]  Closed [0]`,
  with 20+ open ticks in the repo.
- Roadmap view reads "No epics found", with two epics present.
- `tk tui -s all -a` behaves identically. The flags do not widen the scope.

Correlation is exact. Before the run, four ticks carried `awaiting: input`
(o3n, cc5, 9h0, n0r) and the List view showed exactly those four — including
three that were already CLOSED. After clearing `awaiting` on the three closed
ones with `tk update <id> --awaiting ""`, the List view showed exactly the one
remaining. So the view tracks `awaiting`, not status, and not the flags.

Deleting `.tick/.tui-state.json` and restarting does not change it. That file
held `{"activeViewIndex":0,"scope":{"Kind":0,"Smart":0,"Node":""},...}`, so
`Smart: 0` may be a smart-view enum whose zero value is an awaiting/attention
scope rather than "everything".

Possibly relevant: the pane was 80 columns. `tk tui --help` describes a
"navigation sidebar (smart views + project tree)", and no sidebar renders at
that width — so if changing the smart view requires the sidebar, there is no way
to leave the default scope in a narrow terminal. Worth checking whether the bug
is the zero value, the flags being ignored, or both.

Second, smaller bug in the same area: closing a tick does NOT clear its
`awaiting` field. o3n, cc5 and 9h0 were closed (two via `tk close --from human`)
and all three kept `awaiting: input`, so they stayed in the human-attention
queue after being closed. A close should clear the wait state, or the attention
views should exclude closed ticks.
acceptance_criteria: tk tui with no flags shows the repository's ticks, not only those with awaiting set; -s all and -a widen the scope as documented; the Board counts match tk list; the Roadmap view lists the epics tk roadmap lists; closing a tick clears its awaiting field, or the attention views exclude closed ticks; a test covers a repo with open, closed and awaiting ticks.
